subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A new phone was advertised as easy to repair.”?
options: After a storm cut electricity, phones slowly ran out of battery.
She drew simple pictures on paper and passed them around.
Users could replace the battery, screen, and camera with simple tools.
Saying a name correctly is one simple way to show respect.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After a storm cut electricity, phones slowly ran out of battery.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「She drew simple pictures on paper and passed them around.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Users could replace the battery, screen, and camera with simple tools.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
